items.title: 19.1.2 Chemical Composition and Organization of Chromosome (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of chromosome composition and packing (PDF 117-118).

blocks.text: Chromosome taqreeban 40% DNA aur 60% proteins (histones) se bana hota hai. Dono chromatids mein bilkul aik jaise DNA molecules hote hain. Aik aam insani chromosome ka DNA taqreeban 5 cm lamba hota hai aur is mein taqreeban 140 million nucleotides hote hain. Phosphate groups ki wajah se DNA par negative charge hota hai. Histone proteins par positive charge hota hai, kyun ke un mein arginine aur lysine jaise basic amino acids zyada hote hain; is liye DNA aur histones aik doosre ko mazbooti se pakarte hain (strong affinity). Chromosome ki tanzeem (organization) ke darje yeh hain:

Replication ke baad DNA ke taqreeban har 146 nucleotides (DNA 2 nm mota) aik histone octamer ke gird do chakkar lipat-te hain. Histone octamer 8 histone molecules ka set hai: H2A, H2B, H3 aur H4 ki do do copies. Is tarah nucleosomes bante hain. Nucleosomes aapas mein taqreeban 80 nucleotides lambe linker DNA se jure hote hain. Paanchwin qisam ka histone, H1, jise linker histone kehte hain, nucleosome ki bunyad par us jagah hota hai jahan DNA andar aata aur bahar nikalta hai; yeh nucleosomes ki zanjeer ko lapetne mein madad deta hai. Saare nucleosomes (linker histone ke baghair) dhaage mein piroye motiyon (beads on a string) jaise lagte hain; ise nucleosome string (11 nm moti) kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: histone octamer, do tehon wali disc jis ki oopri satah chaar rangeen histones H2B, H3, H4 aur H2A mein banti hai. Saath taqreeban 146 nucleotides ka lehrata DNA. Hara teer nucleosome string ki taraf: DNA teen octamers ke gird lipta hai, jaise dhage par moti, aur nucleosome ki bunyad par histone H1.

blocks.long_description: Labels: H2B, H3, H4, H2A, Histone octamer, DNA (about 146 nucleotides), Nucleosome, H1, Nucleosome string.

blocks.alt: Oopar se neeche aik musalsal khaaka: DNA double helix (2 nm); DNA surkh histone octamers ke gird lipat kar nucleosomes banata hai jo linker DNA se jure hain, har aik par peela linker histone (11 nm); nucleosomes gunjaan ho kar chromatin fibre (30 nm); fibre muR kar loops, yaani supercoil (300 nm); loops mazeed lipat kar condensed chromatin (700 nm); aur aakhir mein duplicate chromosome: aik chromatid 700 nm aur dono chromatids mil kar 1,400 nm.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.4: Chromosome ki tanzeem (kitab ki Figure 19.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: DNA, 2 nm, Histone octamer, Nucleosome, Linker DNA, Linker histone, 11 nm, Chromatin fibre, 30 nm, Supercoil, 300 nm, Condensed chromatin, 700 nm, Chromatid, 700 nm, 1,400 nm.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: DNA darja ba darja lipat-ta hai: DNA 2 nm, nucleosome string 11 nm, chromatin fibre 30 nm, supercoil 300 nm, chromatid 700 nm. Poore duplicate chromosome (do chromatids) ki chaurai 1,400 nm hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 19.4 mein aik chromatid par 1,400 nm likha hai, jab ke kitab ka apna text chromatid ko 700 nm mota batata hai. Sahi yeh hai ke aik chromatid 700 nm hai aur 1,400 nm dono chromatids, yaani poore chromosome, ki chaurai hai. Hamare diagram mein yahi durust dikhaya gaya hai.

Cell division ke shuru ke marahil mein nucleosome string apne mehwar (axis) ke gird dobara lipat-ti hai. Ghane (condensed) nucleosomes mil kar aik mota fibre banate hain jise chromatin fibre (30 nm) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Chromatin ke do hisse hote hain. Chromatin ke ghair fa'al (inactive) hisse gehri pattiyan (dark bands) banate hain aur heterochromatin kehlate hain. Chromosomes ke fa'al (active) hisse euchromatin kehlate hain.
Chromatin fibre khud par mur kar supercoil (300 nm moti) banata hai. Supercoil mazeed lipat aur sukar kar chromatid (700 nm mota) ki shakal le leta hai.

blocks.title: Itna lapetna kyun?
blocks.text: Taqreeban 5 cm lambe DNA ko sirf chand micrometre lambe chromosome mein samana hota hai. Socheiye: dhaaga charkhi par lapeta, phir charkhiyon ki rassi bana kar use bhi lapet diya. Nucleosomes aur fibres isi tarah jagah bachate hain.

blocks.prompt: DNA aur histones aapas mein itni mazbooti se kyun jurte hain?
blocks.explanation: DNA par phosphate groups ki wajah se negative charge hai aur histones par arginine aur lysine ki wajah se positive charge. Mukhalif (opposite) charges aik doosre ko khenchte hain.

items: 146 nucleotides octamer ke gird = nucleosome; nucleosome string 11 nm; H1 linker histone.
Chromatin fibre 30 nm, supercoil 300 nm, chromatid 700 nm.
